appSlug.description: The app slug used in Universal API routes.

actionSlug.description: The action slug used in Universal API routes.

method.description: The provider method selected by the action definition.

operation.description: The action operation, such as read or create.

supports.description: The response controls supported by this action.

queryCapabilities.description: Limits and paging capabilities for this action.

optionalArguments.description: Arguments the action accepts but does not require, with includeArguments=all.

responseFields.description: Field keys the action can return.

slugConflict.description: True when more than one action resolves to this slug.

appId.description: The app that provides this action. verbosity=full only.

appName.description: The app's display name. verbosity=full only.

description.description: What the action does. verbosity=full only.

model.description: The provider model this action uses. verbosity=full only.

controls.description: Response controls and their defaults. verbosity=full only.

responseSchema.description: Definitions for fields the action can return. verbosity=full only.

isSchemaDynamic.description: True when the provider determines the response schema at run time. verbosity=full only.
